source: In-game level-of-detail settings (owner rule: LOD aggressiveness, distance and detail are in-game settings the game passes to geo2map). Every default reproduces the behaviour before these settings existed: view distance 20000 m = the shipped world configs' lod.max_distance_m, terrain detail 1.0 = geo2map's range0_m 250 m, road detail 'standard' = g2m::default_render_road_lod(), map detail 1.0 = default_map_config(). Ranges [AS].

settings.label: Terrain view distance
settings.help: How far terrain is drawn, in metres. Shorter = fewer chunks to build and draw.

settings.label: Terrain detail
settings.help: Scales how far each terrain detail ring reaches (1.0 = the finest ring to 250 m). Higher = finer terrain farther out, more chunks.

settings.label: Road detail
settings.help: Which road classes are painted into the terrain at each distance ring.

settings.label: Map detail
settings.help: Minimap and map line detail: higher = finer lines out to a larger radius.
